final_agent_message:
Implemented D-17 teardown behavior.

- Added shared teardown execution that continues through all registered teardown callbacks and then sends the teardown signal, collecting failures.
- Raises an exception group on Python 3.11+ when multiple teardown errors occur; older Python raises the first.
- Updated context popping so request teardown failures do not prevent request closing, app-context teardown, or context-local reset.
- Added app- and request-context tests for continued cleanup, signal delivery, grouped errors, and restored context proxies.
